title: Accounts Assistant
description:

This role is within the professional services industry and is based in Stalbridge.

- Provide support for month-end and year-end accounting tasks.
- Handle queries related to accounts and resolve discrepancies promptly.

A successful Accounts Assistant should have:
- A strong understanding of accounting principles and practices.

- Attention to detail and excellent organisational skills.

title: Credit Controller
description:
Join a well-established Poole-based retail organisation as a Credit Controller. Known for a friendly and dynamic culture, our client prides itself on their commitment to quality and team development. Conveniently located in Poole, Dorset with easy access and a professional but relaxed work environment, this company values punctuality, staff engagement, and continuous learning. This role offers an immediate start, flexible hours in the mornings, and a chance to be part of a reputable retail sector leader.

What will the Credit Controller role involve?
- Managing a portfolio of customer accounts, ensuring timely and accurate processing of sales invoices and receipts, contributing to smooth financial operations
- Engaging with customers via email and phone to facilitate collections and resolve account queries, supporting cash flow targets
- Collaborating with internal teams to ensure billing accuracy and efficient account management, fostering strong stakeholder relationships
- Assisting with basic financial analysis and reporting, helping to optimise collection strategies
- Maintaining meticulous records, adhering to company policies, and supporting continuous process improvement initiatives

Suitable Candidate for the Credit Controller vacancy:
- Proven experience in sales ledger, credit control, or accounts receivable functions, ideally within retail or a similar sector
- Effective communication skills, both written and verbal, with a confident telephone manner
- Strong organisational skills with attention to detail and the ability to prioritise tasks effectively
- Proficient with Excel; training on company-specific software will be provided
- Positive attitude, punctuality, and the desire to learn and develop within a finance role

Additional benefits and information for the role of Credit Controller:
- Flexible working hours in the morning to suit your routinea
- Casual dress code and a friendly, supportive team environment
- Opportunities to gain experience in credit control and finance operations within a thriving retail business
- Salary will be dependent on experience
- Immediate start available for the right candidate

title: Credit Controller
description:
REED Accountancy and Finance are working in partnership with a leading Poole Based Manufacturing and Warehouse Firm recruiting a Permanent Credit Controller to join a busy and dynamic Finance Team.

CREDIT CONTROL POSITION
- Contract type: Permanent
- Salary - up to £30,000 per annum
- Hours: 40 hours per week
- Monday-Friday 8am-5pm

Details

Effectively manage and control debts. Responsible for collecting invoices and ensure that credit given to customers is monitored whilst providing excellent customer service.

What you will be doing

Act as a main point of contact for customer account queries
- Reconciliation, managing customer portals and integration (EDI)
- Review new and existing accounts for creditworthiness, setting or suggesting appropriate terms and credit limits, considering previous history, credit agency and trade references and other relevant sources of information
- Effectively review, manage and collect customer accounts, prioritising to maximise cash flow whist minimising risk exposure (bad debts)
- Resolve invoice and payment queries promptly and efficiently
- Produce and distribute customer statements of account.
- Produce and distribute customer overdue/reminder letters
- Produce and circulate weekly and ad hoc on stop, credit hold status and other reports.
- Proactive management of new accounts and high value invoices
- Build effective relationships with customers and internal contacts.
- Prepare month end consolidated invoices.
- Escalate significant issues/concerns as necessary

title: Credit Controller
description:
Credit Controller

Job Location: Poole, Dorset

Job Type: Permanent

Salary: Up to £30,000 - £31,000 per annum

Hours: 40 hours per week,Monday - Friday 8.00am - 5.00pm

A long-standing, family-owned business based in Poole are looking to recruit a Credit Controller on permanent contract.

As the Credit Controller, you will be managing customer accounts, collect outstanding debts, and supporting cash-flow performance while delivering excellent customer service.

Key Responsibilities:
- Manage and collect customer debts, prioritising accounts to minimise risk
- Act as main point of contact for customer account, invoice and payment queries
- Hold regular meetings with sales teams to resolve credit issues

- Previous credit control experience
- Strong organisational, analytical and communication skills

description:

- Hours: 37.5 hours per week (typically 8.30am-5.00pm Monday-Friday).

Duties:
